dict.string: 先选画质模式，场景分辨率和帧率再按需调整。想更稳：1080p + 1280x720 + 30 帧补到 60（或 60 帧）；想更清晰：MetalFX 2K + 1600x900 + 60 帧。重启游戏后生效 · choose a picture mode first; scene resolution and frame rate are separate. Steadiest: 1080p + 1280x720 + 30 interpolated to 60 (or 60 fps); sharpest: MetalFX 2K + 1600x900 + 60 fps. Takes effect after relaunching

array.string: 原生 2K（最清晰，最热）· Native 2K (sharpest, hottest)

dict.string: MetalFX 2K：默认，1080p 画布用场景和输出两段 MetalFX 放大到面板，文字更清楚；1080p：约 1919x1323 显示缓冲，不做输出 MetalFX，更凉；原生 2K：使用构建时烘焙的画布（默认构建面向 11 英寸 M5 iPad，2420x1668），文字真正原生，3D 仍按场景分辨率渲染，发热最高，其他面板自动回退；720p：更小缓冲，最省电。 · MetalFX 2K: the default, a 1080p canvas upscaled to the panel by both MetalFX stages for clearer text; 1080p: about a 1919x1323 drawable with no output MetalFX, cooler; Native 2K: the canvas baked into this build (the default targets the 11-inch M5 iPad, 2420x1668) for native text (3D stays at the scene resolution; hottest; other panels fall back); 720p: a smaller drawable, lowest power.

只影响 3D 世界，和画质模式独立。1920x1080 比 1600x900 多 44% 像素，发热明显；1280x720 / 960x540 更省电。重场景掉帧时优先降到 1280x720。 · Affects the 3D world only, independent of the picture mode. 1920x1080 renders 44% more pixels and runs hotter; 1280x720 / 960x540 are cooler. If busy areas drop frames, try 1280x720 first.
帧率上限 · Frame rate cap

30 最省电但最不流畅；60 推荐；120 最顺滑也最热。120 需要 120 Hz 面板，60 Hz 设备自动回退到 60。重启游戏后生效 · 30 saves power but is the least smooth; 60 is recommended; 120 is the smoothest and hottest. 120 needs a 120 Hz panel; a 60 Hz device falls back to 60. Takes effect after relaunching

开启后：30 帧补到 60，60 帧补到 120；120 帧本身没有余量，补帧不生效。约多一帧延迟，快速移动可能有伪影（实验）。重启游戏后生效 · on: 30→60, 60→120; 120 has no headroom, so it does nothing there. About one frame of latency and possible motion artifacts (experimental). Takes effect after relaunching

array.string: 填满屏幕 · Fill the screen

dict.string: 填满屏幕不拉伸画面：相机按屏幕比例取景，呈现时再还原比例。iPad 比 16:9 窄，所以两侧会少一点、上下填满；16:9 保留完整宽度并加黑边。少数 UI 特效可能偏移（实验性）· fill does not stretch: the camera takes the screen's aspect and the present pass restores the proportions. An iPad is narrower than 16:9, so a little is lost at the sides and the height is filled; 16:9 keeps the full width with bars. A few UI effects may sit off (experimental)
边缘平滑（MetalFX 时间抗锯齿）· Edge smoothing (MetalFX TAA)
对 3D 画面做时间性抗锯齿，边缘更稳；可能有轻微拖影，默认关闭。重启游戏后生效 · temporal anti-aliasing of the 3D scene; slight ghosting is possible. Off by default; takes effect after relaunching
重启游戏后生效 · takes effect after relaunching
开启时右上角显示帧率、MetalFX 状态和分辨率，行尾是待补译的着色器数量；关闭后整行隐藏 · shows FPS, MetalFX and resolution in the top-right, with the number of shaders waiting for translation; off hides the line

iCloud Drive 自动备份 · iCloud Drive backup

默认开启。首次启动会提示选择一次 iCloud Drive 文件夹；save 和 game-slot 会自动镜像过去，删 App 也不会丢。选「以后再说」后不再自动提示；要换文件夹，打开下面的开关。 · on by default. The first launch asks once for an iCloud Drive folder; save and game-slot are mirrored there and survive deleting the app. “Later” is remembered, so it does not ask again; to change the folder, turn on the switch below.

打开后，下次启动游戏会清除当前文件夹并重新选择；随后开关自动关闭。 · at the next launch the app forgets the current folder and asks again; the switch then turns itself off.
